product_summary: Krofta Engineering Limited (KEL), New Delhi corporate office + Faridabad (Pali Road, Bajri Industrial Area) factory, claims est. 1983 and 4,000+ installations (source: kroftaengineering.com/about-us/). Real product lines from own site: (1) Dissolved Air Flotation units — Megacell (rectangular, lamella), Unicell / Unicell-R (rectangular), Minicell, Sedicell, Supercell (circular), capacities 5–6000 m3/h, incl. Krofta Air Dissolving Tube (ADT), chemical dosing systems, recirculation pumps, air compressors (source: /dissolved-air-flotation/); (2) Sludge dewatering — Screw Press, Belt Filter Press L-series, Triple Wire Belt Filter Press (BFP-T, gravity drain table + belt press) (source: /sludge-dewatering/); (3) API / CPI / TPI oil-water separators; (4) Flash mixer & pipe flocculator; (5) Conventional and Lamella clarifiers; (6) Tertiary treatment & filtration — activated carbon filter, pressure sand filter, continuous backwash filter, disc filter; (7) ETP / STP / WTP turnkey plants; (8) Ultrafiltration, Reverse Osmosis; (9) Anaerobic technologies, gravity drain table, SAF (source: site nav + /industries-we-served/). Sectors served: pulp & paper, oil & gas/refinery, petrochemical, chemical, dairy, pharma, food & beverage, textile, tannery, sugar, distillery, power, steel, desalination, municipal sewage (source: /industries-we-served/).
comment: Declared HS 842121 (filtering/purifying machinery & apparatus for water) is CORRECT for the core line — DAF units, clarifiers, ETP/STP/WTP, sand/carbon filters, RO/UF are all water-treatment machinery of heading 8421. Status: partial, not wrong — the declaration covers only one of several real product families. Missing from the declaration: sludge dewatering presses (screw press, belt filter press, triple-wire BFP) which are solid/liquid separation machinery of 8474.10 / 8421.29 rather than 8421.21; oil-water separators (API/CPI/TPI) which are 8421.29 (or 8421.19 depending on configuration); pumps, air compressors and air-dissolving equipment supplied as components (8413.81, 8414.59/8414.80); filter media/elements and spares (8421.99); mixing/flocculation equipment (8479.82). Industry claim 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a MISCLASSIFICATION as a primary industry: oil & gas/refinery and petrochemical are only end-user sectors among ~35 listed; the company itself is a water/wastewater treatment equipment manufacturer (machinery, HS 8421/8474), not an oil & gas or chemical producer/trader. No trader signs found — own manufacturing facility in Faridabad with MS/SS fabrication, painting, sandblasting stated on site, so role = manufacturer (own claim, not independently verified). Note: krofta.com is a separate Belgian/Dutch entity (Krofta Waterleau Group) holding the original DAF technology; KEL's relationship to it is not stated on its own site — brand/technology licensing not verified. All product data above is from the company's own website: per project rule 5 this is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line or shipment record was checked in this task (out of scope), so no product line here is corroborated by a customs entry. No registry, revenue or volume data researched.
